patthana16.50:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassana sappaṭigho na hetu ceva na hetuvippayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana16.50:2.1: anidassana appaṭighaṃ hetusampayuttañceva na ca hetuṃ dhammaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭigho na hetuvippayutto ceva na na hetu ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi. anidassana appaṭighaṃ na hetuṃ
